title: Explore the world map
changes: The world map (M) can be dragged with the mouse or a finger, or moved with I J K L.
Zoom in and out with the mouse wheel, a pinch or the + and − keys.
Press C, double-tap or the Centre button to centre the map on your hero: it then follows you.
Your hero keeps walking with the arrows or WASD while the map is open.
